figurative_meaning_en: to make a mocking face or stick out the tongue in derision
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা আমাকে জিভ বার করে হাসল।
সে তার বোনকে জিভ বার করে উত্যক্ত করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The child stuck out his tongue at me and laughed.
She made a face at her sister to annoy her.
note: Commonly used in playful or teasing contexts in Bengali culture
